pains.title: Layout on drop
pains.pain: Widgets sit still until a layout command, and that command jumps them.
pains.test: New form, drop one button, drag the form wider, save. The XML has a layout and no `geometry` on the button. Undo returns to an empty form.

pains.title: Three size words
pains.pain: Size policy, minimum size, and stretch read as three mysteries.
pains.test: Set a minimum size, press Reset, save. The XML has no `minimumSize`. Two buttons in a column, Fill and stretch 1 on the second. Widen the form. The second button grows. The first stays at its text width.

pains.title: Paste into the layout
pains.pain: Paste is refused inside a layout. Band raised by the R3 thread.
pains.test: A vertical layout of three buttons. Copy the middle one and paste. Four buttons. The new one is selected. Undo restores three. The scratch pad can stay for people who want a reusable copy. It is not the only paste path.

pains.title: Rows you can hit
pains.pain: Nested layouts shrink to a line you cannot drop on.
pains.test: A horizontal layout nested in a vertical layout accepts a dropped line edit. Neither layout is broken. The tree order matches the visual order.

pains.title: Break layout asks first
pains.pain: Break layout is the documented way to edit, and it resizes siblings.
pains.test: Two horizontal layouts. Break the first. The second keeps its width. Undo puts the first layout back.

pains.title: Generation never owns the logic file
pains.pain: Edits in `ui_*.py` disappear on the next generation.
pains.test: Put a comment in `forms/name.py`. Change the form. Generate again. The comment is still there. Put a comment in `ui_*.py`, leave it dirty, and generate. The command stops and names the file.

pains.title: Promotion is a Python module
pains.pain: Promotion stores a C++ header and draws the base class.
pains.test: Promote a `QWidget` to `myapp.widgets.Meter`. The saved header is the module path Designer already expects, with `.py` written as `.h`. A preview process imports it. A class that raises in `__init__` shows the error and does not kill the editor.

pains.title: Style sheet matches the form
pains.pain: The style sheet on the canvas is not the style sheet in the app.
pains.test: A rule for `QPushButton#okButton` colors that button. A selector that matches nothing is marked "no match" and can still be saved. Reopen the form. The color is still on that button.

pains.title: Icons come from the resource file
pains.pain: An icon shows in Designer and is gone at runtime.
pains.test: Save is never blocked; a raw-path pixmap is a Problems warning with a fix and blocks packaging (UX_SPEC 13.2.1 D3). After the icon is in the `.qrc`, the canvas and a `QUiLoader` preview both show it.

pains.title: The package list includes the form
pains.pain: A packaged app cannot find the `.ui` file.
pains.test: A fixture project loads `forms/login.ui`. The package step fails when that file is removed from the manifest, and passes when it is present. This test needs a packager fixture. It is not a canvas test.

pains.title: Preview is another process
pains.pain: A custom-widget plugin aborts Designer or the loader.
pains.test: Kill the preview process. The editor still accepts a rename. Restart preview. The form returns.

pains.title: Font preview, not pixel geometry
pains.pain: Sizes are raw pixels, so a font or a scale change blows the form up.
pains.test: Toggle the preview between 10 point and 16 point. The layout reflows. The saved XML for those children has no `x` or `y`.

pains.title: One editing mode for ordinary work
pains.pain: Modes and a dated canvas make people leave the tool.
pains.test: Add a `clicked` connection while a button is selected. The canvas tool does not change. The new row is selected.

pains.title: Gap is a number
pains.pain: Spacers stick, disagree with preview, or forbid a save.
pains.test: Two fields and a button. Run content size. Preview the form at 800 pixels tall. The group stays near its text height. Save and reload. The spacing number is unchanged.

pains.title: Names complete in the logic file
pains.pain: The code editor cannot complete widget names.
pains.test: A button named `okButton` completes as `self.okButton` in `forms/name.py`. Rename it to `saveButton`. The old name is gone from the stub. This test needs the editor's language server, or a generated `.pyi` opened by the same checker the team uses.

pains.title: Connections are a normal list
pains.pain: Signal mode hides new connections.
pains.test: Add a connection. It is visible without scrolling past it on purpose. Delete it. The `<connection>` element is gone. A slot whose arguments do not match the signal is listed in problems.

pains.title: Actions drag onto menus and toolbars
pains.pain: Menus and toolbars do not take the control you dragged.
pains.test: Create Open. Drop it on File and on the toolbar. Save. Both references are in the XML. Reload. The action is in both places. Toolbar widgets that the `.ui` schema cannot store are refused with a sentence, not a silent drop.

pains.title: Enums commit or stay dirty
pains.pain: Enum properties do not commit.
pains.test: Set `echoMode` to Password. Save. Reload. It is Password. A property type the editor cannot change is still present in the XML after save.

pains.title: Splitter handle and stretch
pains.pain: A splitter cannot be nested, and its handle does not move.
pains.test: Two lists in a vertical splitter inside a horizontal layout. Drag the handle. Save. Reload. The sizes match the drop.

pains.title: Tab order follows the picture
pains.pain: Tab order sticks on screen, and new widgets join at the end. Band uses R3.
pains.test: Insert a line edit between two existing ones. The tab list matches visual order. Escape clears the numbers. Move a tab page in the tree. The page order in the XML matches.

pains.title: Grid drop shows the cell
pains.pain: One grid drag moves cells you did not touch.
pains.test: Move a button from cell 0,0 to cell 1,2. Only that item's row and column change. Undo restores 0,0.

pains.title: Slot names are checked
pains.pain: `connectSlotsByName` misses a slot that looks right.
pains.test: A misspelled signal is a problem row. `on_okButton_clicked` for a real `QPushButton` is clean.

pains.title: Large forms stay editable
pains.pain: A huge form freezes inside `setupUi`.
pains.test: Opening a fixture of 400 rows paints a first screen and allows a selection. The runtime check loads the same file with QUiLoader in the preview process. The test records the time. It does not assert a number until a baseline exists.

pains.title: Z-order follows the child list
pains.pain: Undo writes a z-order entry that is not a widget.
pains.test: Repeat the steps in QTBUG-62049. Save. No `<zorder>` entry names a spacer.

pains.title: Rename keeps the keyboard
pains.pain: Rename in the object tree steals the keyboard. Evidence is R3 only.
pains.test: Rename ten widgets from the tree with the keyboard only. Focus is in the name field for each of them.
